Archer use to be a scientist in France, then got transferred to the Untited States to work in the labs over in America. Slenderman had been stalking Archer for years until Archer fell ill to the Slender sickness, making him into a toxic (literally) and lethal proxy, using chemicals and chemistry as his main weapons, but using a pair of duel sickles during close combat.
